title: Psychology Facts
hook: Are you a visual learner? Think again.
facts: Many people believe teaching should match their *learning style*.
Visual, auditory, hands-on: the idea is *everywhere* in schools.
A 2008 review found *little evidence* that it improves learning.
People do have preferences. They just don't predict results.
A map is best seen, whatever your *style*.
outro: You were never just one kind of learner.
